reference.direction: Nine large colored squares in a cross; almost-black cool background matching the fine-grid concept; coarse grid at one cell per block, barely visible.

normalization: Vector reconstruction with equal square tiles, constant spacing, subtle tile gradients, a coarse faint grid and full-bleed background; platform masks supply outer corner shape.

exports.android: Legacy density PNGs plus separate adaptive background, colored foreground and monochrome vectors; mark fits the 66 dp circular safe zone.
exports.web: SVG and PNG favicons, Apple touch icon, 192/512 px home-screen icons and a maskable icon referenced by site.webmanifest
